description: Open the cytochrome c protein FASTA file (cytochrome_c_multispecies.fasta) located at ~/UGENE_Data/ in UGENE. This file contains real cytochrome c protein sequences from 8 evolutionarily diverse species (Human, Chicken, Bread Mold, Hemp, Yeast, Fruit Fly, Horse, and Pig) downloaded from UniProt. First, perform a multiple sequence alignment using the MUSCLE algorithm. Then, build a phylogenetic tree from the resulting alignment using the built-in phylogenetic tree builder. The tree should visually show the evolutionary relationships between these organisms. Save the resulting phylogenetic tree as a Newick format file named 'cytochrome_c_tree.nwk' in ~/UGENE_Data/results/.

metadata.data_source: UniProt cytochrome c sequences (P99999, P67881, P00048, P00053, P00044, P04657, P00004, P62895)
